subject.title: subject
subject.description: The note title / subject — a short headline for the note, e.g. 'Acme — discovery call notes'. The agent should generate a clear, concise subject from the conversation.

content.title: content
content.description:
The note body as HTML. Use tags like

/

,

, ,

    /
  • , and to format it — it is stored and rendered as rich text. Build this from the user's notes, transcript, or summary. Do NOT escape the HTML.

recordId.title: recordId
recordId.description: Optional. The Salesforce 18-character Id of the record this note should be associated with (Account, Contact, Opportunity, or any object). If the user is working on a record, pass that record's Id (e.g. $Input.Account.Id). Leave blank to create a standalone note.
